releaseNotes: v1.18.1: calls now show a proper 'reaching' phase and the no-answer countdown only starts once the other phone is actually ringing; faster call setup; background message sync fix; server-side fix so phones stay reachable after relay restarts. (If you are updating from the OLD Dunes app: this installs as a NEW app - open it, release your @username from the old app's Settings first if you have one, re-add your contacts, then uninstall the old Dunes.)
